title: FrameTrail shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the FrameTrail data schemas.

phpEmptyObject.description: An empty object as PHP writes it. PHP cannot tell an empty JSON object from an empty array, so files written or rewritten by the PHP backend can hold [] where an empty object is meant. Readers treat it as {}.

context.description: The JSON-LD context: ["http://www.w3.org/ns/anno.jsonld", "https://frametrail.org/ns/context.jsonld"]. Older files carry ["http://www.w3.org/ns/anno.jsonld", { "frametrail": "http://frametrail.org/ns/" }], which declares only the prefix, so JSON-LD processors drop the contents of frametrail:attributes, frametrail:events and frametrail:keyframes. FrameTrail itself does not read @context.

created.description: When the item was created. The controllers and undo/redo use it as the identity of an item within its collection, so it is kept unique per collection.

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 date-time (an xsd:dateTime), e.g. "2026-10-06T09:36:45.127Z". Write it in UTC with milliseconds, so that items created within the same second stay distinct.

Legacy. The output of JavaScript's Date.prototype.toString(), e.g. "Mon Jul 06 2026 09:36:45 GMT+0200 (Central European Summer Time)", as FrameTrail used to write it. It has no milliseconds and is not an xsd:dateTime. Readers must accept it.

userId.description: A user id: the key of the user in _data/users.json. A string, except where the PHP backend writes it as a number (ownerId in annotations/_index.json).

creator.description: W3C creator: the user who created the item.

nickname.description: Display name of the user who created the item, as it was at the time.

id.description: Id of the user who created the item. Identifies the owner of an annotation; for overlays and code snippets it is informational.

generator.description: W3C generator: the software that created or last changed the item, as an IRI or an object (e.g. { "type": "Software", "name": "…" }). FrameTrail does not write it; writers keep it.

tags.description: Tags of the item. Tag names are the keys of _data/tagdefinitions.json.

overlayEvents.description: JavaScript run on overlay events. Each value is the body of a function called with the arguments FrameTrail (the instance) and hypervideo (its HypervideoController), with the overlay as this.

onReady.description: Runs once when the overlay has been rendered.

onStart.description: Runs when playback enters the overlay's time span. Quiz and hotspot overlays created in the editor get "FrameTrail.module('HypervideoController').pause();".

onEnd.description: Runs when playback leaves the overlay's time span.

onClick.description: Runs when the overlay is clicked outside the overlay editor.

timeSpanSelectorValue.description: Media Fragments temporal range "t=<start>,<end>" in seconds of the video, e.g. "t=12.5,20".

keyframe.description: One keyframe of an overlay's box motion.

t.description: Time of the keyframe in seconds of the video (absolute, including the clip's in point).

xywh.description: Box [left, top, width, height] in percent of the video frame. Values may lie outside 0–100 (off-frame); width and height are never negative.

r.description: Rotation in degrees, clockwise, around the box centre. Missing means 0.

ease.description: Easing of the segment from this keyframe to the next. Missing means linear; "hold" keeps this box until the next keyframe.

overlaySelector.description: Where and when an overlay is shown.

value.description: Media Fragments "t=<start>,<end>&xywh=percent:<left>,<top>,<width>,<height>": the time span in seconds of the video and the box in percent of the video frame. With keyframes the box is the union of the moving box within the span, clamped to 0–100; without, it is the overlay's box. It is always the unrotated box.

frametrail:keyframes.description: Box motion: the overlay's box over time, sorted by t. While an overlay has keyframes its rotation lives in each keyframe's r, and frametrail:rotation is not written.

frametrail:rotation.description: Static rotation of the box in degrees, clockwise, around its centre. Omitted when 0 and when the overlay has keyframes.

distance.description: Travel distance of slide, drop, shake, bounce, float and glow, in percent of the smaller side of the video stage.

color.description: CSS colour of glow and marker.

animation.description: Overlay animation. Transitions frame the time span: the overlay is fully present and clickable for exactly [start, end]. Missing phases have no animation. Replaces the legacy animationIn / animationOut / animationDuration attributes on the first edit in the Animation tab.

in.description: Entrance. It plays before the overlay's start (lead-in), clipped at the start of the video.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds. Missing means the preset's own duration.

ease.description: Easing. Missing means the preset's own easing.

emphasis.description: Loop that plays within the overlay's time span.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds. Missing means the preset's own duration.

ease.description: Easing. Missing means the preset's own easing.

iterations.description: How often the loop plays. 0 fills the span.

out.description: Exit. It plays after the overlay's end (trail-out).

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds. Missing means the preset's own duration.

ease.description: Easing. Missing means the preset's own easing.

text.description: Text reveal (text overlays), within the span.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds. Missing means the preset's own duration.

ease.description: Easing. Missing means the preset's own easing.

mode.description: Reveal word by word or letter by letter. Missing means the preset's own mode, or word.

stagger.description: Delay between words or letters in milliseconds.

hoverStyle.description: How the overlay changes on hover. Missing means it does not change.

borderColor.description: CSS border colour while hovered. Empty means none.

backgroundColor.description: CSS background colour while hovered. Empty means none.

zIndex.description: Stacking order among the hypervideo's overlays (0 = bottom). Missing means creation order.

animationIn.description: Legacy. Entrance of overlays saved before the Animation tab existed, mapped to animation.in when read. Ignored when animation is present.

animationOut.description: Legacy. Exit of overlays saved before the Animation tab existed, mapped to animation.out when read. Ignored when animation is present.

animationDuration.description: Legacy. Duration of animationIn and animationOut in milliseconds.

action.description: What a click does. Empty means nothing (custom code goes into the overlay's onClick event).

actionTarget.description: Target of the action: a URL for openUrl (one starting with # changes the page hash), seconds of the video for jumpToTime, a hypervideo id for jumpToHypervideo.

actionTargetTime.description: jumpToHypervideo only: the time in seconds to start the target hypervideo at. Empty or 0 means its start.

resourceType.description: The type of a resource in the library, which decides how it is rendered and what its attributes hold. Text, HTML, quiz, hotspot, cursor, counter and chart items are made in the editor and have no resource.
